_comment: Mutations that remove the guarantees added by the $499 'Managed' tier
A is the price the tier is sold at. B is the PRO-block gate in
api/plans.py. C is the alias resolution in PlansConfig.get_plan -- the
`premium` rows must keep working. D and H are the two halves of the
A3 suppression: D stops derive_entitlements from consulting the
deferred list, H empties the list itself. E is the tier ladder, where
`premium` must stay on the same rung as `managed`. F and G are the
marketing page: the price the Managed card shows, and the false
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

I and J are the CURATED HEADLINE: a hand-written summary on the $499 card. Its numbers must be checked against the raw plan, so I (200 live strategies instead of 100) and J (the old wording) must both be killed.

K, L and M are the LIVE-TRADING DISCLOSURE the curated headline had dropped: Managed may trade live on all six venues (allow_real_trading, api/routes/strategies.py:538-554), Standard and Professional both say so on the page, and the $499 card must say it too.

K and M target the MANAGED card and carry its own preceding bullet, because the Standard and Professional cards carry a byte-identical venue line and the Standard card comes FIRST: an ambiguous needle silently mutated the wrong card. N removes the disclosure from the STANDARD card on purpose -- it is killed only by the pre-existing guard test_a_tier_that_may_trade_everywhere_says_so, which is why the harness target now includes tests/test_public_pricing_matches_catalog.py.

O and P are the BILLING-MODE GUARD: the $499 Managed tier is a monthly service and its one-off block is switched off, so the server must refuse a purchase in that mode (O) and the billing page must not offer the tier there (P).
Q and R are the CURATED HEADLINE against the DERIVED ENTITLEMENTS: the headline claims unlimited optimization runs and 100 live strategies, so taking either away must make the pricing guard fail.

mutations.label: A: the Managed tier is priced at $490 instead of $499
B: managed is no longer a PRO-block plan
C: get_plan no longer resolves the premium alias
D: derive_entitlements ignores the deferred-permission list
mutations.replace: if False and permission in deferred_permissions:

mutations.label: E: the premium rung is lowered below managed
F: the marketing page prices the Managed card at $490
G: the marketing page advertises Portfolio backtesting on Standard again
H: the config's deferred-permission list is emptied
I: the Managed headline claims 200 live strategies instead of 100
J: the Managed card reverts to the old 'Managed service.' wording
mutations.needle: We deploy, monitor and adjust your strategies inside the risk limits you set.
mutations.replace: Managed service. We deploy, monitor and adjust your strategies inside the risk limits you set.

mutations.label: K: the Managed card drops the all-venues live-trading disclosure
mutations.needle:
• Highest queue priority, 20 concurrent tasks
  • Live trading on all six exchanges (OKX, Binance, Bybit, Bitget, Gate.io, BingX)

mutations.label: L: the catalog's Managed headline drops the all-venues disclosure
mutations.needle: - "Live trading on all six exchanges (OKX, Binance, Bybit, Bitget, Gate.io, BingX)"

mutations.label: M: the Managed card names only three of the six venues
mutations.needle:
• Highest queue priority, 20 concurrent tasks
  • Live trading on all six exchanges (OKX, Binance, Bybit, Bitget, Gate.io, BingX)
mutations.replace:
• Highest queue priority, 20 concurrent tasks
  • Live trading on all three exchanges (OKX, Binance, Bybit)

mutations.label: N: the STANDARD card drops the all-venues live-trading disclosure
mutations.needle:
• Strategy backtesting
  • Saved strategies
  • Live trading on all six exchanges (OKX, Binance, Bybit, Bitget, Gate.io, BingX)

mutations.label: O: the server stops refusing a purchase in a billing mode the tier is not sold in
P: the billing page offers a tier the server refuses to sell
Q: the Managed tier's unlimited optimization quota becomes 50
R: the Managed tier's live-strategy limit becomes 50
